Measured moduli replaced by outward interval or analytic suprema.
One analytic regularized-frame atlas covers the declared radius.
Chart coverage, differentiability, spectral injectivity, disintegration, and measurability survive adversarial review.

Every citation retrieved from a primary source; Ladgham, Azaïs–Delmas, and Nicolaescu wording follows C094.
